title: Preview selected fields in an authorized inventory-movement report
description: An inventory user selects finite existing movement-report columns and warehouse/product/date filters to preview bounded stock-ledger evidence. Reuse ERP-029 report service and require the current user's existing stock-query menu; do not widen role, warehouse, product or data visibility. Preserve base-unit quantities and explicit unknown history; do not infer cost or stock value. Invalid inputs and missing permission fail closed before report reads. Existing HTTP operation audit records the read-only preview. Development only: no Domain/schema change, migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated catalog exposes a finite allowlist of existing inventory-movement fields; preview rejects unknown columns, inverted dates, invalid thresholds and page size above 200 before report reads.

Preview requires the current user's stock-query menu and reuses existing inventory-movement service for warehouse/product/date filters and stable page data; projects selected columns with unknown-history and base-unit semantics and no writes.
Tests cover allowed/denied users, selected field order, page cap, filters, unknown history, invalid input and no writes; document access and ledger limits.
